description: This file defines an interface for serializing objects to ByteBuffer, likely used within the Apache Fineract project for handling Avro schemas.

classes.name: ByteBufferSerializable
classes.description: An interface that mandates implementing classes to provide a method for serializing objects into ByteBuffer form.

methods.name: toByteBuffer
methods.description: Converts the implementing object into a ByteBuffer; may throw IOException.
